case_title: CHARLES J. MOLOSKY II DDS VS. MARK DANIEL WARMUS et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,028.08 FILED BY MOLOSKY II DDS, CHARLES J. AS TO DEFENDANT WARMUS, MARK DANIEL WARMUS, KERRI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-04-2009 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$29.75) SERVED NOV-05-2009, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT WARMUS, KERRI
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$59.50) SERVED NOV-06-2009, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT WARMUS, MARK DANIEL
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-04-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MOLOSKY II DDS, CHARLES J. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WARMUS, MARK DANIEL WARMUS, KERRI $2,028.08 PRINCIPAL, $89.25 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,117.33 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ORDER OF EXAMINATION ISSUED AS TO DEFENDANT WARMUS, MARK DANIEL HEARING SET FOR MAR-11-2010 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT 506
ORDER OF EXAMINATION RETURNED SERVED, SERVICE DATE: FEB-01-2010 AS TO DEFENDANT WARMUS, MARK DANIEL

SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF MAR-11-2010 IS CONTINUED STIPULATION OF THE PARTIES TO APR-01-2010 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. DEFENDANT WILL PAY PLAINTIFF $200 PER WEEK STARTING 3/15/10 AND EVERY MONDAY THEREAFTER UNTIL PAID IN FULL. IF NO APPEARANCES, CONTINUE EVERY 3 WEEKS FOR PROGRESS REPORTS. DEFENDANT GAVE PLAINTIFF A PHOTO COPY OF HIS WELLS FARGO DEBIT CARD, SO CHARGES CAN BE MADE WEEKLY. IF PAYMENTS DO NOT GO THROUGH, BOTH PARTIES ARE TO APPEAR FOR SCHEDULED PROGRESS REPORTS. DEFENDANT TO BRING IN ALL FINANCIALS. DEFENDANT AGREES TO PAY JUDGMENT PLUS ALL COSTS.
SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF APR-01-2010 IS CONTINUED TO APR-22-2010 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT ON $200 PER WEEK PAYMENT. CONTINUE EVERY 3 WEEKS FOR PROGRESS REPORT.
SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF APR-22-2010 IS CONTINUED TO MAY-20-2010 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT ON $200/MONTH PAYMENT STARTING 3/15/10.
CORRESPONDENCE FROM PLAINTIFF, FILED. DEFENDANT IS PAYING AS SCHEDULED.
SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF MAY-20-2010 IS CONTINUED TO JUN-17-2010 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506 FOR FINAL PROGRESS REPORT.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2010 ORDERED DESTROYED
THE ORDER OF EXAMINATION IS DISCHARGED AS TO DEFENDANT, THE JUDGMENT IS SATISFIED. $200 PER WEEK FOR 14 WEEKS. NO APPEARANCES.
